summary: Find the payment defects that cost money quietly, before real cards hit them.
signature: 12 rule codes, file and line on every finding
highlights: Webhook handlers that never verify a signature - a public endpoint anyone can POST a paid event to
Charge amounts read out of the request body, where the customer picks their own price
Live secret keys in source, in the example env file, or in a browser-exposed variable
Grants written with no event id, so one Stripe retry ships the order twice
requires: python3 (already on macOS and Linux). Reads your project files only. No network, and no Stripe API calls.
notes: Static analysis of your source. It cannot tell whether the webhook is registered in the Stripe dashboard at all - the most common silent failure - and it checks Stripe only, not Razorpay, Polar or Paddle.
